# archestra_agent_subagent_exclusions (Resource)

Auto-subagent-mode exclusions for one agent: subagents removed from its surface while `access_all_subagents` is on (exclusions persist, inert, when it is off). **Authoritative over the agent's entire exclusion list** — every apply replaces the full set, and destroy clears it. Declare at most one per agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One authoritative exclusion set per agent. Exclusions persist while Auto
# delegation is disabled; destroy clears them while preserving the agent.
resource "archestra_agent_subagent_exclusions" "worker" {
  agent_id              = archestra_agent.worker.id
  excluded_subagent_ids = [archestra_agent.restricted.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent UUID. Pass the `id` from `archestra_agent`.
- `excluded_subagent_ids` (Set of String) Target agent UUIDs excluded from the agent's delegation surface. An empty set is valid and clears all exclusions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `agent_id` — the exclusion list has no id of its own

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the parent agent UUID.
terraform import archestra_agent_subagent_exclusions.worker 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
